theater: 塔里寒河谷與塔拉茲城

battle.name: 塔里寒之戰
battle.theater: 塔里寒河谷與塔拉茲城
battle.brief: 一二二一年夏，蒙古軍沿花剌子模北線推進，與土庫曼、吉普恰克與喀喇昆部眾在塔里寒河谷交戰，戰事在塔拉茲城牆與河谷通道之間展開。遠征軍帶來漢人與回回工匠操作的配重投石車，把石彈越過夯土城牆，改變了攻城戰的份量；此役與同年內沙布兒、阿拉木忒的圍城同屬西征的最末一段。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 塔里寒之戰發生在成吉思汗西征花剌子模的最後一段，交戰的兩大系統，一方是蒙古帝國的花剌子模遠征軍，另一方是花剌子模帝國殘存的國家軍與被徵發的中亞部眾。蒙古方面，兵權集中於成吉思汗本部大營，察合台、闊瑞與拔都各領一翼追擊部隊，另有專門的攻城器械隊，由漢人工匠、回回工匠與受降的築城匠組成，負責城牆與城門前的重型器械作業。遠征軍以騎兵為主體，每個射手單位配三至五匹可更替的坐騎，作戰時以四匹為一列縱隊衝鋒，步兵則多為被征服地區的降兵與工匠雜役。防守一方以花剌子模蘇丹穆罕默德二世的中央軍為骨幹，加上河中地區的喀喇昆、吉普恰克、烏茲別克等部族的徵發兵，以及散布在錫爾河下游與塔里寒河谷各城的守軍；其指揮體系是蘇丹、埃米爾與地方酋長三層的依附式徵召，部落兵平時各自聽命於本族首領，戰時才由蘇丹的使者臨時調度，遇上大軍壓境時則各自散走，難以合成軍團。戰區本身是費爾干納盆地經貝德爾山口通向哈薩克草原的門戶，塔里寒河谷南北走向，與橫穿草原的東西商路在此交會，控住河中與草原之間的人馬、糧草與工匠往來，因此控制河谷的一方，就控制了中亞東西交通的一個關節。
countriesEn: The battle of Talas fell in the closing phase of Genghis Khan's campaign against Khwarazm, and the two systems that collided were the Mongol army of the Khwarazm expedition on one side and, on the other, the surviving state troops of the Khwarazmian Empire together with the tribal levies conscripted across Central Asia. On the Mongol side command was concentrated in the great camp of Genghis Khan himself, while Chagatai, Qorchi and Batu each led a wing of pursuing troops; alongside them worked a dedicated siege train, formed of Chinese craftsmen, Huihui craftsmen and surrendered masons, responsible for the heavy engines working in front of walls and gates. The expeditionary army was in its essence cavalry: each shooting unit kept three to five spare mounts and charged in columns of four; the infantry was made up for the most part of surrendered men from the conquered regions and of craftsmen and camp labourers. The defenders were built on the central army of the Khwarazmian sultan Muhammad II, augmented by levies drawn from the Karluk, Kipchak and Uzbek tribes of Transoxiana and by garrisons scattered in the cities along the lower Syr Darya and the Talas valley. Their command structure ran in three dependent layers - the sultan, the amirs and the local chiefs - so that tribal troops obeyed their own leaders in peacetime and were only mustered by the sultan's envoys in war; faced with a mass army they tended to scatter rather than fight as one host. The theatre itself was the doorway from the Fergana valley through the Bedel Pass onto the Kazakh steppe: the Talas valley runs north to south and meets the east-west caravan road of the steppe there, holding the line of horses, grain and craftsmen that moved between Transoxiana and the steppe, so that whoever held the valley held one of the joints of Central Asian east-west traffic.
people: 此役在編年史裏留下的個人名字不多，可以確定的有幾位。蒙古一方的最高統帥是成吉思汗，他自一二一九年冬跨過錫爾河之後，就把戰爭重點由草原追擊轉為逐城攻取，戰事拖到一二二一年夏仍未結束，他本人一直留在前線大營之中。分遣各路的是他的兒子察合台與拔都，以及妹夫闊瑞；闊瑞的部眾在戰略上負責肅清已被突破的後方、切斷糧道與追擊散兵，是蒙古軍能在異鄉長期駐紮的關鍵。花剌子模的蘇丹穆罕默德二世已於一二二〇年病死於里海東岸，主持河中防務的是他的諸子與諸埃米爾，其中札闌丁滿古爾比在同年秋仍率殘軍退戰於帕爾萬與呼羅珊一線，未能回援塔里寒。防守方的部族首領多不具名，只以喀喇昆、吉普恰克等部族名見於記載，這些部族在蒙古人到來之前長期倚靠花剌子模的徵召與保護，也正因如此才被捲入這場戰役。真正決定戰役技術層面的，還有一批名字幾乎完全消失的工匠：蒙古軍中的漢人砲手與回回砲手，前者把中原的製繩、配重與絞盤技術帶到中亞，後者是花剌子模本地人，世代操作配重投石車，熟悉牆體承重、落點修正與射程換算，兩批人在攻城的第一線被編為器械隊，隨大營推進而重新編組。
peopleEn: The chronicle of this battle preserves few personal names, but a few can be fixed with confidence. The supreme commander on the Mongol side was Genghis Khan, who, after crossing the Syr Darya in the winter of 1219, had shifted the war from pursuit across the steppe to the taking of city after city; the fighting was still unfinished in the summer of 1221 and he remained in the forward camp himself. The columns sent out in different directions were his sons Chagatai and Batu and his brother-in-law Qorchi; Qorchi's men were given the task of clearing the broken rear areas, cutting supply lines and running down stragglers, and that was what allowed the Mongol army to sit in a foreign land for long stretches. The Khwarazmian sultan Muhammad II had died on the eastern shore of the Caspian in 1220, and the defence of Transoxiana fell to his sons and his amirs, of whom Jalal al-Din Mangburni was still fighting a losing battle around Parwan and Khurasan in the autumn of the same year and could not come back to the Talas valley. The tribal leaders of the defenders are mostly nameless, appearing in the record only as Karluk, Kipchak and similar tribal designations; these peoples had long depended on Khwarazmian mustering and protection before the Mongols arrived, and that dependence is exactly what drew them into the war. What actually decided the technical side of the fighting was a body of craftsmen whose names have almost entirely vanished: the Chinese artillerymen and the Huihui artillerymen in the Mongol host. The former carried Central Chinese techniques of rope-making, counterweights and windlasses into Central Asia; the latter were local Khwarazmians who had worked counterweight trebuchets for generations and knew the load of a wall, the correction of the fall of the stone and the conversion of ranges. Both groups were organised into the engine teams and reorganised as the great camp advanced.
kits: 卡面這架配重投石車，是十二世紀初已經成熟的歐洲式巨砲：長臂由配重拉起，拋石靠重力與瞬時釋放把石彈拋過城牆，歐洲的攻城戰中十二世紀已有實戰記錄，一二二一年時在歐洲與西亞都已是標準攻城器械。蒙古遠征軍攜帶的同類器械在漢文史料中被記作回回炮，多由回回工匠操作，與中原的十字弩、火矢、猛火油一同列在蒙古軍的攻城裝備之中。配重投石車在體系裡的位置很清楚：它不是野戰武器，而是決定城防崩壞與否的工程器械，單台發射的石彈重數十公斤，大型者可達百公斤以上，拋送距離約一百至三百公尺，一次齊射可在城頭造成連續崩落，使守軍無法長期據牆而守。它的價值還在於射程與破壞力可以壓過城頭的直射與守方投石，又能停在遠離牆根的位置作業，不會像貼牆的撞木那樣暴露在弓弩之下。與它配套的還有撞木、雲梯、填壕用的土袋車、封鎖城門道路的拒馬，以及蒙古騎兵慣用的長距離迂迴。防守方亦有守城用的配重投石車與弓弩，城內的水井與儲水同樣是守城一方能撐多久的關鍵，攻城方若不能封水，就只能改用長期圍困的辦法。
kitsEn: The trebuchet on the card is a European-type great engine that had already matured in the early twelfth century: a long arm hauled up by a counterweight, the stone thrown by gravity and the sudden release of the rope, a machine with battle records in European sieges during the twelfth century and by 1221 a standard instrument of siege in both Europe and West Asia. The same class of engine carried by the Mongol expedition is recorded in Chinese sources as the huihui pao, worked for the most part by Huihui craftsmen, and it is listed together with the Central Chinese crossbow, fire arrows and liquid fire among the siege equipment of the Mongol army. The place of the counterweight trebuchet in the order of battle is quite clear: it is not a field weapon but a piece of engineering whose effect decides whether a wall comes down. A single engine throws a stone of several tens of kilograms, the larger ones over a hundred, with a range of roughly one hundred to three hundred metres, and a single salvo can bring down a stretch of battlement, denying the defenders the chance to hold the wall for long. Its value lies as much in out-ranging the direct fire and the defending engines on the wall as in the fact that it can be worked well away from the foot of the wall, where a battering ram would be exposed to bows and crossbows. Working with it were rams, scaling ladders, earth bags for filling ditches, barricades to close the roads leading from the gates, and the long-range encirclement by Mongol horsemen. The defenders had their own counterweight engines and bows and crossbows, and the wells and cisterns inside the walls decided how long a siege could be held out; if the besiegers could not seal off the water, they had no choice but to fall back on the slow method of a protracted blockade.
tactics: 蒙古軍在塔里寒河谷的作戰，延續了成吉思汗西征以來形成的一套攻城與野戰混合辦法。野戰上，蒙古騎兵以多路縱隊平行推進，強迫對方把隊形拉成一條線，再以迂迴的一翼插入其側背，把敵軍分割成數段；遇到部族聯軍不肯正面會戰、只以騎射周旋時，蒙古人寧可收縮包圍、封住水源與草場，也不願在無水的河谷裡一路追擊到底。攻城上，重點是切斷而非硬撞：先以配重投石車與弓弩覆蓋城頭與城門，逼守軍縮回城內；再封住出入道路，切斷城內的柴草與糧食，逼守軍在期限內出降；若城防堅固，蒙古人便在城外紮營屯田、就地徵集工匠與糧秣，把圍城變成長期作業。器械隊的作業規矩極細：投石車先試射校準射程與落點，再對城頭的薄弱處集中打擊；一套完整的配重投石車連同絞盤、配重、備件與維修的人手，需要數十名操作者與隨軍技師，這也是蒙古軍在攻城時屢屢需要大量俘獲工匠的原因。遠征軍同時靠嚴格的搶掠禁令維持軍紀，戰利品集中保管，減少了守軍被激怒而拼死抵抗的可能，也讓蒙古營地可以在異國土地上長期駐紮。
tacticsEn: The fighting in the Talas valley followed the mixture of siege and manoeuvre that had taken shape during Genghis Khan's campaign. In the field, Mongol horsemen advanced in parallel columns, forcing the enemy to draw out into a single line, and then drove a turning wing into the flank to cut the enemy into segments; when tribal confederations refused to meet them in battle and only skirmished from horseback, the Mongols preferred to close the ring and seal off water and grazing rather than chase deep into a waterless valley. In siege the principle was to cut rather than to batter: first the counterweight trebuchets and the bows and crossbows covered the parapet and the gates, driving the defenders back inside; then the roads in and out were sealed, cutting off firewood and grain and pressing the garrison to surrender within a fixed term; where the walls held, the Mongols camped outside, tilled the ground, drew craftsmen and provisions from the neighbourhood and turned the siege into a long piece of work. The engine teams worked to a tight routine: the trebuchets fired trial shots to correct range and fall of point, and only then concentrated fire on the weak places of the wall. A complete counterweight engine, with its windlass, counterweight, spare parts and the men to maintain them, needed several dozen operators and travelling technicians, which is why the Mongol army so repeatedly had to take craftsmen prisoner. The expedition kept discipline in the field through a strict ban on plunder, with booty collected and guarded centrally; that reduced the chance that a garrison, angered, would fight to the last, and it allowed Mongol camps to stand for long periods in foreign territory.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，以下幾項來自不同時期的記載，只宜當作量級參考。蒙古軍在花剌子模戰役中的總兵力，波斯與蒙古史家的說法在一十萬到二十萬之間，中文史料一系則概稱大軍十餘萬；其中真正用於圍城與攻城的工匠與器械隊，比例遠低於騎兵。花剌子模方面，蘇丹在戰前能召集的兵馬約十萬上下，但這支軍隊在布哈拉與撒馬爾罕陷落後已大部崩解，到一二二一年在河中與錫爾河下游能作戰的，多是臨時徵發的部族兵。地理方面，塔里寒河全長約八百公里，自吉爾吉斯山區流向哈薩克斯坦西南部，河道在塔拉茲附近收束；自費爾干納的奧什經貝德爾山口到塔拉茲的車馬路程約三百公里，谷地寬處可達二三十公里，順風順水時日行數十里不成問題，這說明河谷是一條可以快速調動騎兵與輜重的走廊。器械方面，十二世紀的配重投石車臂長約十至十五米，拋石常在五十至一百五十公斤之間，大型者更重，操作人員從二十到上百不等，發射距離約一百至三百公尺；蒙古軍在花剌子模的圍城中確實使用了這類器械，記錄並給出單台需數十人操作的量級。戰役的具體傷亡與俘獲數字，在現存殘缺記載中無從確定，不宜妄加推算。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are few, and the following come from accounts written at different times, so they should be treated as orders of magnitude rather than exact numbers. For the total strength of the Mongol army in the Khwarazm campaign, the Persian and Mongol historians range from a hundred thousand to two hundred thousand, while the Chinese tradition speaks in general terms of a hundred thousand and more men; the proportion of engineers and engine crews actually employed in siege work was far lower than the proportion of cavalry. On the Khwarazmian side, the sultan could raise something like a hundred thousand men before the war, but that host had largely disintegrated after the fall of Bukhara and Samarkand, and by 1221 what could still fight in Transoxiana and along the lower Syr Darya was for the most part freshly mustered tribal levies. Geographically the Talas river runs for about eight hundred kilometres from the mountains of Kyrgyzstan down into south-western Kazakhstan, where the channel narrows near Taraz; the caravan distance from Osh in Fergana by the Bedel Pass to Taraz is about three hundred kilometres, and the valley opens to twenty or thirty kilometres in its broader stretches, so a column of horsemen and baggage could make good tens of kilometres a day with wind and water in its favour. As for the engines, a twelfth-century counterweight trebuchet had an arm of roughly ten to fifteen metres, threw stones commonly of fifty to a hundred and fifty kilograms and more in the larger machines, needed from twenty to more than a hundred men to work, and had a range of about one hundred to three hundred metres; the Mongols did use machines of this kind in the Khwarazmian sieges, and the record gives the order of magnitude of several dozen men to a single engine. Exact casualty and prisoner figures for this battle cannot be established from the fragmentary sources that survive, and no attempt should be made to invent them.
cause: 戰爭的起因可以分成近因與深因兩層。近因是花剌子模與蒙古之間的關係在十二世紀初急劇惡化：花剌子模的使節在蒙古營地與商路上多方凌辱、殺害蒙古使者與商旅，蒙古方面的報復性襲擊又打到花剌子模境內的訝魯與別答克等城鎮，把原本存在於草原與河中之間的商旅糾紛變成了國家級的衝突。深因是河中與草原之間的控制權之爭：錫爾河下游的牧場、鹽池與商路是花剌子模的重要稅源，蒙古人南下之後，兩邊都要爭奪部落的歸屬與商道的通行費；此前依附花剌子模的喀喇昆、吉普恰克等部眾，在蒙古壓力下倒戈或被裹挾，令花剌子模在北翼多線作戰，一二二〇年冬布哈拉與撒馬爾罕的陷落更抽走了它的骨幹。還有一層常被忽略的技術與制度起因：蒙古人原先沒有可用的攻城能力，遠征軍在攻撒馬爾罕等城時才第一次系統性地組織工匠隊、籌措木材、建立配重投石車與撞木的供應，因此任何一場以攻取城池為目標的戰役，都要求他們把圍城變成一門可以反覆施行的技藝，而這正是塔里寒河谷一役真正的壓力所在。
causeEn: The causes of the war fall into a proximate layer and a deeper one. The proximate cause was the rapid souring of relations between Khwarazm and the Mongols in the early twelfth century: Khwarazmian envoys insulted and killed Mongol envoys and merchants in the Mongol camp and along the trade roads, and the retaliatory raids that followed reached Khwarazmian towns such as Otrar and Nevak, turning a quarrel of merchants and envoys between the steppe and Transoxiana into a clash between states. The deeper cause was a struggle over control between the steppe and Transoxiana: the pastures, salt pans and caravan roads of the lower Syr Darya were a principal source of Khwarazmian revenue, and once the Mongols moved south both sides had to fight for the allegiance of the tribes and for the tolls of the trade route; the Karluk, Kipchak and other peoples who had formerly attached themselves to Khwarazm either defected under Mongol pressure or were swept along with it, which forced the empire to fight on several fronts along its northern wing, and the fall of Bukhara and Samarkand in the winter of 1220 struck at the core of its strength. A third cause, often overlooked, is technical and institutional: the Mongols had no usable siege capability at first, and it was only during the attacks on Samarkand and the other cities that the expeditionary force first organised teams of craftsmen on a systematic scale, gathered timber, and set up a supply of counterweight trebuchets and battering rams. Any war whose object was to take cities therefore demanded that they turn siegecraft into a craft that could be applied again and again, and that, rather than any single manoeuvre, was the real pressure behind the fighting in the Talas valley.
impact: 這場戰役的直接影響，是塔里寒河谷與其下游的交通線正式落入蒙古軍的掌握，中亞的東西往來自此要向蒙古的驛騎與監察讓路；同年稍後，蒙古人在申河擊潰札闌丁，接著把兵鋒轉回花剌子模境內的花剌子模城與呼羅珊方向，河中與草原的部眾則被拆散編入蒙古的十戶制與千戶制，成為蒙古帝國人力與騎兵資源的來源。技術上的影響更為持久：蒙古人把配重投石車與回回工匠的技術帶進東亞，隨後在攻西夏、攻金與後來的南宋戰役中使用，成為東亞攻城的主幹器械之一，而原本只屬於西亞與歐洲的工程知識，就這樣在十三世紀上半葉完成了跨洲的轉移。更深一層，這一戰顯示草原霸權第一次具備了攻城能力，也就把它從劫掠型戰爭推向了以佔領與治理為目的的戰爭；此後蒙古在俄羅斯與歐洲中部的推進，用的正是同一套方法與同一批工匠。戰略層面亦留下一個教訓：遠征軍主力遠離北方主戰線，直接影響了三年後迦勒迦河之戰中蒙古軍無法集中兵力應對的結果。
impactEn: The direct effect of the battle was that the lines of communication through the Talas valley and its lower reaches passed formally into the hands of the Mongol army, and movement east and west across Central Asia henceforth had to make way for the Mongol relay posts and their inspection; later in the same year the Mongols broke Jalal al-Din at the Indus and then turned their arms back toward the Khwarazmian cities and Khurasan, while the peoples of Transoxiana and the steppe were broken up and enrolled in the decimal system of the Mongol host, from ten-man units to thousand-man ones, becoming a source of manpower and horses for the empire. The technical consequences were the more durable: the Mongols carried the counterweight trebuchet and the skills of the Huihui craftsmen back into East Asia, where they were used in the campaigns against Western Xia, against Jin and later against Southern Song, and the counterweight siege engine became one of the principal instruments of East Asian siegecraft, while engineering knowledge that had belonged to West Asia and Europe alone was transferred across continents in the first half of the thirteenth century. At a deeper level the battle showed that a steppe power had acquired the capacity to take cities, and so moved it from war of raid to war of occupation and government; the later Mongol advance into Rus and central Europe used exactly the same methods and the same craftsmen. Strategically it left a lesson as well: with the main body of the expedition drawn far from the northern front, the Mongols could not concentrate their forces when they faced the Kalka three years later.
result: 結果是蒙古軍在塔里寒河谷打開了局面：花剌子模一方的聯軍在縱深不足、補給靠不住的條件下被分割擊潰，河谷南北的通道、貝德爾山口通向費爾干納的商道與塔拉茲一帶的城池接連落入遠征軍手中，守軍或降或散，部族兵多被就地收編，編入蒙古的怯薛與軍隊編制。此役之後，成吉思汗的戰略重心由中亞轉向花剌子模本土的花剌子模城、哈吉與呼羅珊方向；札闌丁的殘部退往波斯與亞美尼亞一線，蒙古騎兵在追擊與掃清殘敵之間往返，一二二一年底再於申河與其交鋒。對兵器史而言，結果同樣清楚：配重投石車在這條戰線上被證明是把遠征戰變成攻城戰的關鍵器械，蒙古軍靠它與同類的撞木、雲梯配合，一次又一次在數日到數十日的時間內拿下花剌子模的城池；同一套技術與同一批工匠，隨後又在西夏、金與南宋的城牆前重複了這一遍。
resultEn: The result was that the Mongol army broke the situation open in the Talas valley: the Khwarazmian confederation, without depth and without reliable supply, was cut up and beaten; the north-south passages of the valley, the trade road over the Bedel Pass into Fergana, and the towns around Taraz fell into the hands of the expedition in succession, garrisons surrendering or scattering, and tribal levies being enrolled on the spot into the Mongol keshig and army units. After this the strategic centre of gravity of Genghis Khan moved from Central Asia toward Khwarazm proper, toward the cities of Khwarazm, Herat and Khurasan; Jalal al-Din's remnants withdrew toward Persia and Armenia, and Mongol horsemen rode back and forth between pursuit and mopping up, meeting him again at the Indus before the end of 1221. For the history of arms the result is just as clear: on this front the counterweight trebuchet was shown to be the key instrument that turned an expedition into a siege war, and with battering rams and scaling ladders it allowed the Mongols to take Khwarazmian cities time and again in periods of days or weeks; the same technology and the same craftsmen were to repeat the performance before the walls of Western Xia, Jin and Southern Song.
